name: Mar Y Sol
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Mar Y Sol in Füssen!**

Discover the sun and sea atmosphere in the heart of the **Allgäu**! Our family-run hotel invites you to relax in a cozy setting, just a short walk from the picturesque **Füssen** old town and the majestic **Hohenschwangau Castle**.

Enjoy our authentic Bavarian hospitality with regional specialties like **Obatzda**, fresh **Brez’n**, and hearty **Schweinshaxe**. After a day of exploring the **Alps**, unwind with a glass of local **Weißbier** or a warm **Glühwein** by the fireplace.

Whether you're hiking in the **Alpsee** or visiting the fairy-tale castles of **Neuschwanstein** and **Hohenschwangau**, Mar Y Sol is your perfect retreat. Experience Bavarian warmth with a Mediterranean twist—**Willkommen in Füssen!**
